subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw own this Agentic OS-specific lease and session RPC contract in core, or should the capability live behind an external integration and a minimal generic seam?
rationale: This choice determines the permanent Gateway API, shared-state, compatibility, and authorization ownership; it cannot be resolved safely from the contributor patch alone.

options.title: Require a generic core seam
options.body: Pause this PR until a Gateway/session owner sponsors the core contract and narrows it to reusable owner-neutral primitives, with Agentic OS behavior outside core.

options.title: Route to an external integration
options.body: Keep the feature in an Agentic OS plugin or owner repository if current extension surfaces can host the lease lifecycle and orchestration behavior.

options.title: Accept core ownership
options.body: Explicitly approve the Agentic OS-named RPCs and shared snapshot state as a supported long-term core Gateway contract, then require upgrade and current-head live proof.

recommendation.title: Require a generic core seam
recommendation.body: Pause this PR until a Gateway/session owner sponsors the core contract and narrows it to reusable owner-neutral primitives, with Agentic OS behavior outside core.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor connected to the proposed contract; a Gateway/session owner should be added by maintainers before making the product decision.
